title: Is FIFA world cup streaming accessible to visually disabled persons? Delhi HC seeks broadcaster ZEE's response
description: The Delhi High Court has sought the response of ZEE Entertainment Enterprises Limited to a plea raising concerns that the online stream of the FIFA World Cup 2026 in India, which is exclusively broadcast on ZEE 5, is not accessible to persons with visual disabilities.ZEE had secured exclusive rights to broadcast FIFA World Cup 2026 in India.
